text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I fell just one step short...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: 'If I'd only done this, if I'd only done that'—it keeps spinning around in my head, and I'm so pissed...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, mopin' around
ain't gonna make my legs any faster, now is it?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I just didn't work hard enough!
Then all I gotta do is give it my all for the next race!"
choice_data_list: Keep it up and let's do our best!
Let's refocus and get fired up again!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! First I gotta figure out why I lost!
'Cause I don't wanna go makin' the same mistake again!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So, keep yer hopes up for my next race, okay!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Ever since I missed 1st place, I've been prepared for this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"P-Please whip me into shape
real hard for our next race!"
